itinerary_items_schedule_chk.name: itinerary_items_schedule_chk
itinerary_items_schedule_chk.value: ("itinerary_items"."start_time" IS NULL OR "itinerary_items"."start_date" IS NOT NULL) AND ("itinerary_items"."end_time" IS NULL OR "itinerary_items"."end_date" IS NOT NULL) AND ("itinerary_items"."start_time" IS NULL) = ("itinerary_items"."start_time_zone" IS NULL) AND ("itinerary_items"."end_time" IS NULL) = ("itinerary_items"."end_time_zone" IS NULL) AND ("itinerary_items"."end_date" IS NULL OR ("itinerary_items"."start_date" IS NOT NULL AND "itinerary_items"."end_date" >= "itinerary_items"."start_date"))

lead_activities_body_chk.name: lead_activities_body_chk
lead_activities_body_chk.value: ("lead_activities"."body" IS NULL OR char_length("lead_activities"."body") BETWEEN 1 AND 2000) AND CASE WHEN "lead_activities"."type" IN ('note', 'call', 'message') THEN "lead_activities"."body" IS NOT NULL WHEN "lead_activities"."type" = 'automation' THEN "lead_activities"."body" IS NOT NULL AND char_length("lead_activities"."body") <= 500 WHEN "lead_activities"."type" IN ('created', 'stage_changed') THEN true ELSE "lead_activities"."body" IS NULL END

lead_activities_stage_chk.name: lead_activities_stage_chk
lead_activities_stage_chk.value: CASE WHEN "lead_activities"."type" = 'stage_changed' THEN "lead_activities"."stage_from" IS NOT NULL AND "lead_activities"."stage_to" IS NOT NULL AND "lead_activities"."stage_from" <> "lead_activities"."stage_to" ELSE "lead_activities"."stage_from" IS NULL AND "lead_activities"."stage_to" IS NULL END

lead_activities_owner_chk.name: lead_activities_owner_chk
lead_activities_owner_chk.value: CASE WHEN "lead_activities"."type" = 'owner_changed' THEN "lead_activities"."owner_to" IS NOT NULL AND "lead_activities"."owner_from" IS DISTINCT FROM "lead_activities"."owner_to" ELSE "lead_activities"."owner_from" IS NULL AND "lead_activities"."owner_to" IS NULL END

leads_email_chk.name: leads_email_chk
leads_email_chk.value: "leads"."email" IS NULL OR ("leads"."email" = lower("leads"."email") AND char_length("leads"."email") <= 254)

leads_lost_reason_chk.name: leads_lost_reason_chk
leads_lost_reason_chk.value: ("leads"."stage" = 'lost') = ("leads"."lost_reason" IS NOT NULL) AND ("leads"."lost_reason" IS NULL OR char_length("leads"."lost_reason") <= 200)

leads_next_action_chk.name: leads_next_action_chk
leads_next_action_chk.value: ("leads"."next_action_note" IS NULL OR ("leads"."next_action_date" IS NOT NULL AND char_length("leads"."next_action_note") <= 200)) AND ("leads"."next_action_date" IS NULL OR ("leads"."stage" NOT IN ('paid', 'lost') AND "leads"."archived_at" IS NULL))

leads_submission_chk.name: leads_submission_chk
leads_submission_chk.value: ("leads"."idempotency_key" IS NULL) = ("leads"."submission_hash" IS NULL) AND ("leads"."submission_hash" IS NULL OR "leads"."submission_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

outbox_events_lease_chk.name: outbox_events_lease_chk
outbox_events_lease_chk.value: ("outbox_events"."status" = 'processing') = ("outbox_events"."lease_token" IS NOT NULL) AND ("outbox_events"."lease_token" IS NULL) = ("outbox_events"."lease_until" IS NULL)

trips_travel_dates_chk.name: trips_travel_dates_chk
trips_travel_dates_chk.value: ("trips"."start_date" IS NULL) = ("trips"."end_date" IS NULL) AND ("trips"."start_date" IS NULL OR ("trips"."start_date" <= "trips"."race_date" AND "trips"."race_date" <= "trips"."end_date"))
